spoken_summary: An African leader thanks Donald Trump, who responds by complimenting his "such good English, such beautiful." Trump then asks, "Where did you learn to speak so beautifully? Where were you educated?" The leader replies that he was educated in Liberia. Trump says, "Well that's very interesting. Beautiful English," and adds, "I have people at this table can't speak nearly as well."

central_claim: Donald Trump made a condescending and ignorant remark to the Liberian President by expressing surprise at his eloquent English, questioning if he was educated, despite English being the official language of Liberia.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as ignorant, condescending, and potentially racist.
uncertainty_flags: While the post's text identifies the man Trump is speaking to as the 'Liberian President', the video itself does not explicitly confirm his identity.
